definitions.explanation: The art of arranging flowers in a vase or container. A formal, literary synonym for ikebana (生け花). Used particularly in written and academic contexts.

examples.japanese: {挿花|そうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I attend a flower arrangement class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{床|とこ}の{間|ま}→床の間：05797_tokonoma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{挿花|そうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飾|かざ}ってあった→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: A flower arrangement was displayed in the tokonoma alcove.

examples.japanese: {挿花|そうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ひとつ⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Flower arrangement is known worldwide as one of Japan's traditional arts.

notes:
Composed of {挿|そう} (to insert) + {花|か} (flower). A literary and formal term for flower arrangement. In everyday speech and most contexts, ⟦{生|い}け{花|ばな}→生け花：05409_ikebana⟧ or ⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧ are more commonly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {挿花|そうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧: flower arrangement practice
- {挿花|そうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧: to learn flower arrangement
- {挿花|そうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: a flower arrangement work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生|い}け{花|ばな}→生け花：05409_ikebana⟧: ikebana -- the most common everyday term for Japanese flower arrangement
- ⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧: the way of flowers -- emphasizes it as a traditional art or discipline
- {花道|かどう}: alternate writing of the same term (less common)
- {投|な}げ{入|い}れ: nageire -- a specific casual style of flower arrangement
